title: DEP-SEC: replace client jsdom with happy-dom (close conflicting Dependabot #302)
intent: Dependabot #302 started as jsdom 25→30, then pivoted to happy-dom after jsdom 30 / undici 8 broke Vitest. That branch went DIRTY against main. Land the happy-dom migration on current main with a clean lockfile, full per-file @vitest-environment updates, and Node 22 for client lint-build CI. Keep #302 closed.
behavior_change: Client Vitest DOM environment switches from jsdom to happy-dom (dev/test only). Client lint-build workflow runs on Node 22. Production runtime bundle unchanged.

diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot #302 is closed/DIRTY and cannot be the merge vehicle. Human re-land on current main is required for a conflict-free lockfile and complete migration (per-file env overrides).
